scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop:install && npm run start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:install && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.play: npm run build && npm run start -w server
